CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFAPPLET

CFAPPLET writes the APPLET tag for a Java applet that was registered on the Applets page of the Administrator, with the registered code location, size and parameter defaults. Attributes on the tag override the registered values for this one page.

Category

Forms

Syntax

<CFAPPLET APPLETSOURCE="applet_name"
    NAME="form_variable_name"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    VSPACE="pixels"
    HSPACE="pixels"
    ALIGN="alignment"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text"
    param_1="value"
    param_n="value">

Attributes

APPLETSOURCE
Required. Name under which the applet is registered in the Administrator.
NAME
Required. Name of the applet in the page (and of the form field its value would be submitted in).
HEIGHT
Optional. Height in pixels. Defaults to the registered height.
WIDTH
Optional. Width in pixels. Defaults to the registered width.
VSPACE
Optional. Space above and below the applet, in pixels.
HSPACE
Optional. Space to the left and right of the applet, in pixels.
ALIGN
Optional. Left, Right, Top, Middle, Bottom and so on. Defaults to the registered alignment.
NOTSUPPORTED
Optional. HTML shown by browsers that cannot run Java. Defaults to the registered text.
param_n
Optional. Any parameter registered for the applet, by name, overriding its registered default value.

Usage

An unregistered APPLETSOURCE throws an error. KoldFusion ships with two registrations, copytext and marquee, and you can add your own on the Applets page.

Today's browsers no longer run Java applets, so what visitors see is the NOTSUPPORTED text. The tag is kept so that 1999 pages still run; view the page source to admire the generated APPLET tag. The applet's value is not submitted with the form.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFFORM NAME="News" ACTION="cfapplet.cfm">
<P>Today's headline ticker:
<CFAPPLET APPLETSOURCE="marquee" NAME="Ticker" WIDTH="400"
    NOTSUPPORTED="<I>Your browser cannot run Java, so here is the news
    as text: KoldFusion 4.5 ships! Y2K compliance certified!</I>">

<P>An applet that nobody registered:
<CFTRY>
  <CFAPPLET APPLETSOURCE="dancing_hamster" NAME="Hamster">
<CFCATCH TYPE="Any">
  <CFOUTPUT><I>#CFCATCH.Message#</I></CFOUTPUT>
</CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
</CFFORM>
